front: What is Webhook in one sentence?
back: One-line: server-to-server HTTP callback on events — receiver must verify, dedupe, and respond fast — not a reliable message bus.

front: Explain the mental model of Webhook (how the system thinks).
back: Publisher (Stripe, GitHub, Slack) POSTs an event payload to your HTTPS URL when something happens. Delivery is best-effort with retries — your endpoint must be idempotent and quick (ack, then process async).

front: What are the production-safe defaults for Webhook?
back: [ ] HTTPS only; valid cert [ ] Verify signature (every request — no exceptions) [ ] Constant-time compare for HMAC [ ] Idempotency key (event.id, X-GitHub-Delivery, Idempotency-Key) [ ] Respond 2xx within provider timeout (often 5–30s) [ ] Process async (queue/worker) [ ] Log delivery ID, not full secrets [ ] Rotate webhook secrets; support du…

front: Symptom: No events arriving — what do you check and fix?
back: Check: Publisher dashboard delivery log · Fix: URL wrong; tunnel expired; DNS/firewall

front: Symptom: All return 401/403 — what do you check and fix?
back: Check: Signature secret mismatch · Fix: Update secret; ensure raw body for HMAC

front: Symptom: 400 invalid signature — what do you check and fix?
back: Check: JSON parser ran before verify · Fix: Use express.raw() on webhook route only

front: Symptom: Duplicate side effects — what do you check and fix?
back: Check: Same event.id processed twice · Fix: Idempotency store (Redis/DB unique constraint)

front: Symptom: Publisher stopped retrying — what do you check and fix?
back: Check: Returned 4xx on transient error · Fix: Return 5xx only when you want retry; 2xx if ignored intentionally

front: Symptom: Timeouts in publisher log — what do you check and fix?
back: Check: Handler > 30s · Fix: Move work to queue; return 200 immediately

front: Symptom: Works in staging, not prod — what do you check and fix?
back: Check: Different secret / URL · Fix: Separate endpoints per env

front: Symptom: SSL errors on receive — what do you check and fix?
back: Check: Cert chain, TLS version · Fix: Fix cert; use provider-minimum TLS

front: Symptom: Out-of-order events — what do you check and fix?
back: Check: Normal for distributed systems · Fix: Design for ordering per aggregate; use version fields

front: Gotcha with Webhook: what silently fails?
back: Return 200 only after durable enqueue — if you 200 then crash before queue write, event is lost forever (publisher won't retry).

front: When should you NOT use Webhook?
back: High-volume internal events → message queue (MQTT, Kafka, SQS) with at-least-once semantics. Client browser callbacks → CORS + user session; webhooks are server-to-server. Need guaranteed ordering globally → webhook + retry isn't enough; use ordered stream.
